observations.notes: Opened a fresh lab root in Dolphin, then Return entered 01 原件. Native double-click entered Pictures/周末散步. The lab fixture was prepared separately; all tested file mutations used Dolphin UI.
Clicked the parent breadcrumb from 03 移动 to the lab root. Alt+Up and Alt+Left also navigated correctly throughout the native operations.
Clicked Downloads, Documents, Pictures and Trash in native Places. Titles and visible content correspond to each destination.
Ctrl+1 changed the lab root to icon view; Ctrl+3 returned to details. Three-folder selection remained visible.
Ctrl+A selected the long Chinese/Latin filename and later all three folders. Home then Shift+Down selected two JPEGs. Selection counts and highlights were inspected.
Ctrl+C on the original; Alt+Up, Down, Return entered 02 复制; Ctrl+V copied. Read-only checks confirm both original and copy match the source bytes.
Ctrl+X on the copy; Alt+Up, Down, Return entered 03 移动; Ctrl+V moved it. The copied source disappeared, the destination hash matches, and the original remains unchanged.
F2, Ctrl+A, Unicode text entry and Return renamed the moved file to 已整理 · Weekend.txt. Content is unchanged and the previous name is absent.
Delete moved only the disposable renamed fixture to Trash. The native Trash view and Restore to previous location menu were inspected. Trash was not emptied.
Clicked native Restore to previous location, then Alt+Left returned to the destination. The file reappeared with its original bytes; the original lab source is preserved.
Return on the selected landscape JPEG in Dolphin opened Gwenview through the configured default handler. No direct renderer command was used for this check.

Ctrl+Alt+P on the native Dolphin selection opened, closed, and reopened one preview window. Repeated invocation did not accumulate windows. With two JPEGs selected, Alt+Right advanced Earthrise 1/2 to landscape 2/2; Alt+Left returned, then Escape closed the preview. The preview motion sequence is recorded separately.

Escape dismissed the preview, retained the selected file, and returned the active KWin UUID to the same Dolphin window: {378a7df2-be9a-43ec-9e1e-b43897540eb4}. Before/after inventories confirm the focus identity.

Clicked the download link on the local HTTP fixture in native Firefox. The completed download popover showed 周末路线(2).txt; Show in Folder opened Dolphin Downloads with that file selected. The 428-byte result matches the fixture SHA-256. Earlier translation-popover interference was resolved by dismissing the offer; failed operator captures are excluded.

Clicked the fixture’s plain file input, selected 06-山间河流.jpg in the native KDE portal, and returned to Firefox with that filename shown in the input. The fixture has no upload form or upload request; no file was uploaded.

Opened the existing offline aven-demo draft. Before editing, captured unchanged Chinese content at the canonical 1000×840 frame (460,140) and wrapped 720×840 frame (600,140). Appended 已保存本轮草稿，周末见。 using native composer input, Ctrl+S saved, closed the composer, then reopened the Drafts row. The newly saved sentence remained visible. No mail was sent.

In Gwenview, Right changed landscape 2/5 to portrait 3/5 and Left returned to landscape 2/5, with original representative motion frames inspected. Native fullscreen entry and Escape return worked; Alt+F4 returned to Files.

additional_observations.notes: Opened the selected PDF, Chinese text, WAV, and WebM through the Dolphin preview shortcut. PDF and text render actual content. WAV shows 0:00/0:02 and playback controls. WebM changes from the bud poster at 0:00/0:05 to a later frame with slider progress and Pause control after Space. Playback audio was not audibly assessed. Escape closed each preview.
